phrases.english: Can I have the bill, quickly?
phrases.korean: 이거 빨리 계산해 줄 수 있어요?
함께 쬐는 햇살, 더 밝은 날.

phrases.english: Sky of stars, your light with mine.
phrases.korean: 별이 찬 하늘, 네 빛과 내 빛.

phrases.english: Each new word, a step forward.
Be the sunlight, on a bloom.
New Korean word, heard. It stuck!
A single clear sound, echoes further.
Love, a silent echo, finds you.
Small lights, guide the long night.
Like a persistent vine, reach high.

phrases.korean: 비 온 뒤 해, 더 밝게 빛나요.

phrases.english: River carves stone, with time's touch.
Be a guiding star, in darkness.
Share your warmth, like the sun.
A small stream, can fill oceans.

phrases.korean: 천천히 숨 쉬어, 할 수 있어.

phrases.english: Taste new flavors, think new thoughts.
Wait for the bloom, then gather.

phrases.korean: 바다가 숨 쉬고, 당신의 진전이 흘러요.
한 번 듣고, 두 번 말해요.

phrases.english: A small kind act, ripples out.
Listen with heart, to their story.
Offer a kind word, when it's hard.

phrases.korean: 덜 ᄽᮧ인 길, 당신의 것이 되네.
긴 길 가도; 편안한 숨, 쉬세요.

phrases.english: A gentle breeze, a happy sigh.
Plant roots deep, wind matters less.
Joy's quiet bloom, in my soul.
Sky looks wider, my heart does too.
A soft smile, starts the day.
Your small step today plants a seed for a vast forest tomorrow.
phrases.korean: 오늘 당신의 작은 발걸음이 내일의 거대한 숲을 심습니다.

phrases.english: The whisper of your courage is louder than the roar of your doubts.
phrases.korean: 당신의 용기의 속삭임은 당신의 의심의 포효보다 큽니다.

phrases.english: Find the quiet power within you; it doesn't need to shout.
phrases.korean: 당신 안의 조용한 힘을 찾으세요. 소리칠 필요가 없습니다.

phrases.english: Each breath is an invitation to rewrite your narrative.
phrases.korean: 각 호흡은 당신의 이야기를 다시 쓸 초대장입니다.

phrases.english: Unfold your potential like a map, one unexplored route at a time.
phrases.korean: 당신의 잠재력을 한 번에 하나의 탐험되지 않은 경로로 지도를 펼치듯 펼치세요.

phrases.english: Flavor blooms slow, savor it all.
Too much hurry, spoils the soup.
Your plate whispers, listen to it.
Today's effort, is tomorrow's strength. Settle in.
phrases.korean: 오늘 수고, 내일 힘. 자리 잡자.

phrases.english: See small progress, feel big quiet. Breathe deep.
phrases.korean: 작은 발전, 큰 조용함. 깊숨 쉬자.

phrases.english: A kind deed, creates gentle waves. Let's flow.
Found today's rhythm. Calm settling down.
Learned something new. Quiet satisfaction awaits.
Screens dim gradually, real world sharpens.
Chasing likes fades, real likes bloom.

phrases.korean: 더 깊이 뿌리내려, 더 높이 자라.

phrases.english: This side dish, a hidden gem.
Tough days, pass. Strong spirit, lasts.
phrases.korean: 힘든 날, 가고. 강한 정신, 남죠.

phrases.english: Choose rest, before you burn out.
Hold your truth, not your anger.
Hang up, let your mind rest
Slow down, your pace is fine.
Trust the process, one day at a time.
Keep going, even when it’s hard.
My pace is enough, I trust.
I can handle this, step by step.
phrases.korean: 이거 해낼 수 있어, 한 걸음씩
phrases.transliteration: igeo haenal su isseo, han georeumssik

phrases.english: Keep going, even slowly, you will arrive.
phrases.korean: 천천히 가더라도 계속 가요, 결국 도착해요.
phrases.transliteration: cheoncheonhi gada-do gyesok gayo, gyeok-guk dojakaeyo

phrases.english: Again today, you can start over.
Take one small step, then another.
phrases.korean: 작은 한 걸음, 또 한 걸음.
phrases.transliteration: jageun han georeum, tto han georeum

phrases.english: No matter what, keep your rhythm.
When it’s hard, rest, then continue.
I love you, and I mean it.
When you smile, I feel warm.
I miss you, more than words.
Be brave, even when you’re unsure.
You can do it, one small step.
phrases.korean: 할 수 있어, 아주 작은 걸음.
phrases.transliteration: hal su isseo, aju jageun georeum.

phrases.english: It’s okay to be nervous, start.
I forgive, and I move on.
Let it be, I choose peace.
You did your best, that’s enough.
Do you have this in a larger size?
Slow down, and hear the rhythm.
I practice, even when it's hard.
One sentence at a time, please.
Ask again, I can figure it out.
Hold on, it will get better.
Tomorrow is closer than you think.
Keep going, your Korean will get easier.
phrases.korean: 계속 가세요, 한국어가 더 쉬워질 거예요.
phrases.transliteration: Gyesok gaseyo, hangugeo-ga deo swiwojil geoyeyo.

phrases.english: Practice a little, everyday, with kindness.
Say it again, and don’t rush.
phrases.korean: 한 번 더 말해요, 서두르지 마세요.
phrases.transliteration: Han beon deo malhaeyo, seodu-euriji maseyo.

phrases.english: Today’s hard part, tomorrow’s easy part.
I’m counting to ten, one by one.

phrases.korean: 두 개로 먼저 해요, 그다음 시작해요.
phrases.transliteration: du gaero meonje haeoyo, geudameun sijakhaeyo

phrases.english: I only need three minutes, okay?
I have five tickets, not six.
phrases.korean: 표는 다섯 장이에요, 여섯 장 아니에요.
phrases.transliteration: pyo-neo dasot jang-ieyo, yeoseot jang anieyo

phrases.english: Question first, then share your answer.
Hi! I'm happy to meet you.
Hello there, how are you doing?
Good to see you again today.
How’s your day going so far?
Take a deep breath, say it again.
phrases.korean: 숨 한번 크게 쉬고, 다시 말해요.
phrases.transliteration: sum hanbeon keuge shigo, dasi malhaeyo

phrases.english: No worries, you’ll figure it out.
Slow down, it helps a lot.
Say it again, with a smile.
Breathe in, and soften your shoulders.
phrases.transliteration: Sum-eul deul-i shi-go, eo-kkae-reul bu-deu-reop-ge pul-eo-yo.

phrases.english: Notice the air, feel your body.
phrases.transliteration: Gong-gi-reul a-ra-chae-go, mom-eul n y k eo-yo.

phrases.english: Let thoughts come, then fade gently.
Slow down, your mind will follow.
Unclench your jaw, relax right now.
phrases.transliteration: Teok-ui him-eul pul-go, ji-geum pyeon-an-hae- jyeo-yo.

phrases.english: I’m meeting her at 3 p.m., today.
phrases.transliteration: oneul ohu set si e manna.

phrases.english: It’s already past seven, isn’t it?
We should leave now, before it gets late.
I wake up around six, every day.
phrases.transliteration: naneun maeil yeots si- jjumeul il-eona.

phrases.english: Can we talk later, after work?
phrases.korean: 일 끝나고 나중에 얘기할 수 있어?
phrases.transliteration: il kkeutnago najung-e yaegi-hal su isseo?
